{{Quote|Sorry, sir. We tried to stop them, but they left the outpost&mdash;AGH!|The trooper's final words|<ref name="AoI" />}}
This '''clone trooper''' was stationed on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Tyzen Xebec]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ganch]] constructing fortifications for non-military purposes. When the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Devaron outpost]] was attacked by a task force led by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], he survived long enough to report the abduction of Master Ropal and his [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|holocron memory crystal]] before being killed by enemy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|General Skywalker! Our base has been overrun! There's no possibility of evacuation. They've taken General Ropal and the holocron memory crystal!|Clone trooper reporting to General Skywalker|<ref name="AoI" />}}
[[File:DevaronTrooperDeath-AoI.png|thumb|left|200px|The trooper is killed by battle droids.]]
He and his fellow [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were assigned to help build non-military fortifications on the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] under the leadership of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Bolla Ropal. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] launched a surprise attack with a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] task force on loan from [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. When General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived aboard [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] to render assistance, he reported that the Republic outpost had been overrun and Master Ropal had been captured by the enemy forces. While still offering his report, he was killed when his position was overrun.<ref name="CoD" /><ref name="AoI" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] this clone stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|Imperial standard meter]].

==Equipment==
This trooper utilized white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] and a standard [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the episode, the clone was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone troopers through the series.
